sentences.text: Many people know how to capture screen into a file on Mac by using <kbd>Command<kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>3</kbd> for a full screenshot and <kbd>4</kbd> for cross hair selection tool.

sourceRef.title: Capture screen into clipboard instead of file on Mac

sentences.text: However, I found I want to paste the captured image into an editor directly more than saving the image into a file.

sentences.text: The hotkey for taking a screenshot to the clipboard is very inconvenient, which is <kbd>Control</kbd> + <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>3</kbd> or <kbd>4</kbd>.

sourceRef.title: Capture screen into clipboard instead of file on Mac
